A '''Human male''' served as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant's]] [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Group]] in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]]. He was one of four pilots who served as emissaries to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]] in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]]; led by 181st [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]], they attempted to convince the government of the nation state of [[Cartann]] to join the Empire. Meanwhile, four [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] pilots were also in [[Cartann City]], arguing the New Republic's case. During their [[Standard day/Legends|days]] on Adumar, the Imperial pilots engaged many local pilots in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|aerial duels]] to the [[Death/Legends|death]], which gained them considerable honor according to local customs.

When Cartann declared [[Adumari Civil War|war]] on the other nations of Adumar, the Imperials fought for them when forces of the [[Yedagon Confederacy]] attacked Cartann. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was the first Imperial pilot to die, which happened when his [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptor]] was shot down by concentrated fire from the New Republic pilots, who were fighting for the Confederacy.

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]'', one of Phennir's men is described as being a tall, [[Color/Legends|red]]-[[Hair/Legends|headed]] man. It is unclear if that man is the pilot described in this article or one of the [[Unidentified 181st pilot 2|two]] [[Unidentified 181st pilot 3|other]] men on Phennir's ambassadorial team.
